# A2.03 User story writing

## Owner
A2

## Stage
Understand

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
—

## Input (reads)
Feature list or story text from the manifest

## Steps
1. Write each story as: As a <role>, I want <goal>, so that <benefit>.
2. Use only roles and goals in the source.
3. Mark any missing role or benefit TBD

## Output (writes)
User stories with IDs and source IDs

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/stories/<ID>/stories.md`

## Verification
Every story has role, goal and benefit, or TBD

## Checkpoints raised
- none
